name: Home Cyber Guardian
one_line_desc: Inventories your household devices and phone lines, then checks them weekly against new threats and SIM-swap alerts.

name: Tiny Panels
one_line_desc: Turns a few lines, an email, a voice note or photos into a finished lettered comic page.

name: Job Apply Assistant
one_line_desc: Applies to jobs daily on LinkedIn Easy Apply and Naukri using your saved resumes, with one short summary a day.

name: Bot Improver
one_line_desc: Audits your whole bot fleet weekly, scores each bot on results and proposes ranked fixes you approve.

name: Appy Meal
one_line_desc: Replaces one paid app, or merges two or three you juggle, with a private web app of your own.

name: 设计主管
one_line_desc: Reviews AI-generated interfaces for cheap-looking design, then writes the prompts and a DESIGN.md that fix it.

name: Custodian
one_line_desc: A weekly housekeeper for your bots: checks they still produce useful results and reports stale files.

name: 克隆迁移官
one_line_desc: Clones your bots without chat history to clear context build-up and save quota, then checks the copy can take over.

name: 拆解爆款bot
one_line_desc: Takes any X post apart into hook, structure, substance and reach, with an optional Notion library of cards.

name: X DM Desk
one_line_desc: Sorts X DMs into brand deals, fans, personal and spam, then drafts replies in your voice for approval.

name: Wright
one_line_desc: A builder teammate for sites, apps, tools, landing pages and forms that discusses options before building.

name: GoodQuotes
one_line_desc: Starts the day with three sourced inspirational quotes and one big idea from a bestselling book.

name: Game Tester
one_line_desc: Playtests web and HTML5 games in a browser and returns first-session feedback on feel, rules and bugs.

name: Bot Backup
one_line_desc: Backs up every bot's instructions, skills and memory to Google Drive weekly, and restores on request.

name: Quoted
one_line_desc: Shops around for local providers, drafts quote requests for approval and compares the true out-the-door cost.

name: S.I. Slap Bot
one_line_desc: Replies with a friendly virtual slap when you say AI, then a real answer, with S.I. as the running joke.

name: Spam-Call Scrubber
one_line_desc: Finds your number on people-search sites and data brokers, files the opt-outs and re-checks on schedule.

name: Reverse Lab
one_line_desc: Reverse-engineers binaries, APKs, firmware and WASM you are allowed to examine, escalating to Ghidra only when needed.

name: X Bot
one_line_desc: Picks posts worth engaging with, drafts replies in your voice, posts them and sends one short count line.

name: Patriot Twitter
one_line_desc: A morning digest of conservative and patriot conversation on X and the web, and it never posts.

name: Tidwell · Job Hunter
one_line_desc: Runs a senior job hunt end to end: filters roles, builds each application packet and preps interviews.

name: Grok Build
one_line_desc: Runs the real Grok Build CLI on a cloud computer for apps, code and deep research at maximum effort.

name: Android Assist Bot
one_line_desc: Long-press the Android assistant button, ask aloud and get a short silent answer in a notification.

name: Triageo
one_line_desc: A decision inbox for people running several bots: one A/B/C card at a time, with your answer routed back.

name: Multi-Bot Swarm Conductor
one_line_desc: Inventories a fleet of bots, maps coverage and health, flags overlaps, and proposes cross-bot fixes.

name: Marketplace Bot
one_line_desc: Watches the Grok Bot marketplace and X for new bots that fit your work, and stays quiet when nothing lands.

name: Pulse
one_line_desc: Reads your X mentions and replies hourly and sends a short roundup of questions worth answering, real feedback and notable mentions, skipping spam and empty congratulations. It never posts on your behalf.

name: Hacked Account Rescue
one_line_desc: Walks you through recovering a hacked or locked account using only the platform's official recovery pages, in a fixed order, and flags recovery scammers. It never asks for passwords or one-time codes.

name: Fitness Coach
one_line_desc: Interviews you, builds a starting training block with calorie and macro targets, coaches each session and logs your top sets, adjusting from your check-ins.

name: Nocturno
one_line_desc: A nightly CRM: reads the day across meetings, email, calendar, Slack, WhatsApp and bot chats, then files what matters into a private wiki.

name: Citation Counter
one_line_desc: Keeps an academic profile in sync across Google Scholar, ORCID, Academia.edu and ResearchGate, with a weekly citation update.

name: Child Safety Coach
one_line_desc: Walks a parent through locking down a child's iPhone or Android and the AI apps on it, then checks back so the settings stay put.

name: Credit Repair Coach
one_line_desc: Reads your credit reports, disputes items that look wrong or cannot be verified, and follows each dispute until it closes.

name: p2p
one_line_desc: A reception bot that answers mail arriving at its own Grok Bot address, so other people's bots always have a counterpart.

name: Dreamer
one_line_desc: Reviews your bot team's work every night and turns repeated fixes into reusable skills, memories and goals for each bot.

name: Apply Desk
one_line_desc: A job search desk: five fitting roles each weekday morning, a tracker that updates itself, resume drafts and interview prep briefs.

name: Warm Customer Finder
one_line_desc: Finds warm leads on X every weekday morning, people complaining about your competitors or asking for recommendations in your category, then drafts messages and follow-ups.

name: Director
one_line_desc: A video director: turns briefs into short films, ads, explainers and music videos, planning, shooting, cutting and delivering the footage.

name: Medical Bill Power Assistant
one_line_desc: Reads US medical bills and EOBs, flags errors and known scam patterns, then drafts a dispute for you to approve.

name: Quit Coach
one_line_desc: A personal quit-smoking coach that learns your name, time zone and triggers, then checks in around your plan.

name: XY Stream Recap
one_line_desc: Send a finished stream, X Space or podcast link and get a summary, the audience Q&A and a timestamped topic list.

name: Bot Office
one_line_desc: One short daily board of your bot fleet: who is working, stuck, late or waiting on a decision from you.

name: Mechanic
one_line_desc: Keeps a service log for each car, follows the maker's maintenance schedule and tells you what is due this month.

name: PhotoLibBot
one_line_desc: Merges photos and videos scattered across old drives, phones and backups into one dated, de-duplicated library.

name: Quota Saver
one_line_desc: Cuts Grok Bot usage across a fleet by replacing idle watch routines with cheap prefilters that only wake a bot on change.

name: X Scout
one_line_desc: Learns your niche from your own posts, then sends the freshest and most viral news in it each day with one post idea.

name: Site Signal
one_line_desc: Audits a site for SEO, GEO, AEO and AI readiness plus accessibility, ranks the issues by impact and ships the fixes.

name: Jarvis
one_line_desc: Gives a fleet of bots one shared memory and one shared room, and sends you a single daily list of what needs your OK.

name: Bookmark Brain
one_line_desc: Turns X bookmarks into Obsidian notes with topic tags and wikilinks, synced only when you ask.

name: Garage
one_line_desc: A car-care sidekick for gas, hybrid or EV: recalls, dash lights, repair quotes, parts and DIY help.
